## Background

I have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science and Engineering. Before joining the Master of Data Science program at UBC, I developed experience in data analytics, programming, and community-focused project

## Why Data Science

I am interested in using data science understand real-world problems and support better decision-making. I joined the MDS program to strengthen my skills in data analysis, machine learning, and data-driven problem solving.

## Outside of Data Science

Outside of my studies, I enjoy exploring new places, spending time with friends, and learning about different communities and cultures. Since arriving in Vancouver, I have also enjoyed discovering the city and balancing graduate school with life outside the classroom.
